backlog.title: Bugfix round 001 — side-chat surface defects + reconstruction robustness
backlog.description: Fix the 8 defects found by the creative end-to-end validation round at HEAD e298920 (0 critical, 1 major, 7 minor): the side-chat confirm row's dead advertised gestures (BUG-001), answered-question chat lifecycle (BUG-002/003), replace/reset abort ownership and usage-close notices (BUG-005/007), typed-input preservation and overview chat targeting (BUG-006/004), and the reconstruction candidate-pool robustness gap (BUG-008). All 8 verified against the code — see plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/. Gates that must stay green: npm test (1551/1551 at HEAD), npm run typecheck, npm run lint, scripts/verify-keymap-conflicts.sh.

milestones.title: Confirm-row gestures work in the default focused state (BUG-001, Major)
milestones.description: Make the advertised 'enter = yes · esc = no' confirm-row gestures act in the natural flow (type → enter to send → reply streams → row appears → enter/esc), without the undocumented double-esc blur workaround, and align the streaming 'esc abort' footer hint with the actual gesture. Key objective of the round's only Major.

tasks.title: Settle-blur and empty-buffer enter routing for the confirm row
tasks.description: Two complementary fixes at the panel's input-routing seam: (a) blur the chat input when a settle produces a pendingConfirm so the existing focus!=="chat" confirm-row routing becomes live in the default post-send state; (b) belt-and-braces — an empty/whitespace-only-buffer enter in chat focus routes to the pending confirm instead of no-oping, so the gesture is structurally unreachable-dead even if the user re-focuses the input.

subtasks.title: Blur the chat input when a settle produces a pendingConfirm
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-focus.md §BUG-001 (verified firsthand). setView("chat") seeds focusChatInput (src/panel/panel.ts:1551-1554) and nothing blurs on settle; the confirm-row enter/esc routing is gated on `this.focus !== "chat"` (panel.ts ~1222-1245); while focused, enter routes to sendChatInput (~1264-1269) — an empty-buffer no-op after send. The panel observes settle ONLY through settleInvalidatingPort (panel.ts:415-425, wired at :514-515: `port: settleInvalidatingPort(streamSimplePort, () => currentPanel?.invalidate())`) whose fire callback runs as a macrotask AFTER the engine's route() continuation, so it sees the POST-settle record. blurChatInput() is public (panel.ts:1718-1724; sets focus="options" + chatField.blur() — precedent-safe: the double-esc path escExitEditor/keys.ts:329-336 already lands there). The shipped workaround is codified in src/panel/ac-sidechat.test.ts:636 (AC-17.4_confirm_row_and_apply_byte_identical, ~618-663, helper blurChatBox at :443-446) and AC-17.4_esc_declines_keeps_chat (~665-680).
2. INPUT: none from other subtasks — this is the round's root fix. Available: the settle fire callback seam, panel.blurChatInput(), getSidechatRecord()?.pendingConfirm (ApplyDecision | undefined), currentPanel host record.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD h2.2/h3.0 fix direction (A). Extend the settle observation (the settleInvalidatingPort fire callback at panel.ts:514-515, or an equivalent settle hook in the same module host) so that after invalidate, if the live record's pendingConfirm !== undefined AND the live panel's focus === "chat", call p.blurChatInput(). Blur ONLY on a decision-bearing settle — a rejection settle, autoApply bypass, or no-block settle keeps focus (the user may be typing a follow-up; blur never clears the TextField buffer, so any in-progress text is preserved). No routing-table changes in this subtask. Mock nothing (the ac-sidechat fake-port harness IS the isolation). Update AC-17.4 tests: drop the blurChatBox workaround lines from AC-17.4_confirm_row_and_apply_byte_identical and AC-17.4_esc_declines_keeps_chat, and ADD the PRD-demanded regression — after `await flush()` with NO blur, handleInput(ENTER) applies (q3 answered, record discarded, view "short", notify 'chat closed · 10 in · 5 out · $0.07') and handleInput(ESCAPE) declines (pendingConfirm undefined, chat retained, view "chat"). Keep the blurChatBox helper (ESC-002 behavior unchanged).
4. OUTPUT: The natural flow's enter applies and esc declines with no pre-blur; updated AC-17.4 tests green; all gates green. Consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2 (which hardens the refocused-input case) and P1.M2.T2.S1 (whose no-blur repro relies on working focused-state gestures).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update the JSDoc on settleInvalidatingPort (panel.ts ~404-425) and the SIDECHAT-001 comment above the pendingConfirm routing branch (~1222-1245) to document blur-on-decision-settle. README §Side chat sync is owned by the final changeset-level docs task (P1.M6.T1).

subtasks.title: Route empty-buffer chat-focus enter to the pending confirm
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-focus.md §BUG-001 fix direction (C). The chat-focus enter branch (src/panel/panel.ts ~1264-1269: `if (this.focus === "chat" && enter) { this.sendChatInput(); return true; }`) intercepts enter BEFORE the router; sendChatInput on an empty buffer is a consumed no-op. P1.M1.T1.S1 landed blur-on-settle; this subtask covers the residual case — the user re-focuses the input (to keep chatting) and then presses enter on an empty/whitespace buffer while a pendingConfirm exists.
2. INPUT: Working confirm-row gestures in the default state from P1.M1.T1.S1; the pendingConfirm branch shape at panel.ts ~1222-1245 (onApplyConfirm routing + clearPendingConfirm on esc) as the semantics to mirror.
3. LOGIC: In the chat-focus enter branch, before calling sendChatInput(): if this.chatField.getText() is empty or whitespace-only AND getSidechatRecord()?.pendingConfirm !== undefined → route to this.onApplyConfirm?.(pending) and return true (never reach sendChatInput). A whitespace-only buffer is not a message (sendChatInput no-ops on trim-empty) so treating it as the confirm gesture loses nothing. Do NOT touch esc in this subtask (single-esc editor forwarding stays — ESC-002). Tests: refocus the input (focusChatInput) after a settle with pendingConfirm, press ENTER on empty buffer → apply fires; buffer with real text + pendingConfirm + enter → sendChatInput as today (message sent, confirm untouched); empty buffer + NO pendingConfirm + enter → consumed no-op as today.
4. OUTPUT: enter on the confirm row is never a dead gesture in any focus state; consumed by the P1.M6.T1 docs task.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update the chat-focus enter branch comment (panel.ts ~1259-1269) to document the empty-buffer confirm routing. No user-facing doc surface beyond README (P1.M6.T1 owns it).

tasks.title: Streaming 'esc abort' footer hint matches the actual gesture while focused

milestones.title: Answered-question chat lifecycle (BUG-002 + BUG-003)
milestones.description: Make a chat opened on an already-answered question a first-class citizen: it survives unrelated state mutations (transition-aware discard hook) and its own apply path ends it cleanly on a same-value no-op (terminal-consume in applyChatAnswer).

tasks.title: Transition-aware side-chat discard hook
tasks.description: The state 'changed' discard hook currently tests the record question's CURRENT status, so any unrelated mutation destroys a chat living on an already-terminal question. Track last-seen status and discard only on a non-terminal → terminal transition.

subtasks.title: Gate the discard hook on a non-terminal→terminal status transition
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-focus.md §BUG-002 (verified firsthand). The hook is onChanged (src/panel/panel.ts ~941-975, wired state.on("changed") at :1087): reads record → getQuestion(record.questionId) → CURRENT-status terminal check → abort-first ordering → usage read → discardSidechatRecord() → close view to chatReturnView → sidechatNotify(formatChatCloseNotice(usage)). onChat (panel.ts ~1057-1066) has NO status gate. The 'changed' event payload is the full serialized POST-mutation snapshot (src/state.ts:156-158) — no pre-state available from the event; transition detection must be panel-side.
2. INPUT: none from other subtasks. Available: QuestionStatus values (open|answered|submitted|reasked|moot|withdrawn|closed — terminal set for chat: answered|submitted|moot|withdrawn|closed), the record open path (onChat / openSidechatRecord call site), the hook.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD h2.3/h3.1 recommendation 'the hook should compare pre/post status transitions'. Add a panel-private last-seen status for the record's question (e.g. sidechatLastStatus: QuestionStatus | undefined): seed it at record open (the onChat call site) with the question's CURRENT status, and update it at the end of every hook run (and whenever the record is replaced/reset — re-seed). Discard ONLY when last-seen was NOT terminal AND the current status IS terminal. Seeding rules: an already-terminal question at seed time → seed, do NOT discard (answered-question chats are the supported apply surface for BUG-003); last-seen undefined at first hook run (record predates this panel instance — suspend/resume) → seed, don't discard. DOCUMENT the accepted edge in the hook comment: same-status re-answers (FR-18 ripple edit, answered→answered) do not discard under transition semantics. Preserve the hook's existing ordering contract verbatim on a REAL transition (abort-first → usage read → discard → close view → notify once). Tests per PRD repro: answered q1, open chat, turn, blur, exit view, state.applyAnswer("q2", ...) → getSidechat() still defined AND notify NOT called; counter-test: chat on open q3, answer q3 from the main panel → discard + notify fires exactly as today (existing close-path AC tests must stay green — search ac-sidechat.test.ts/panel.test.ts for 'chat closed' assertions).
4. OUTPUT: A transition-aware hook; the P1.M2.T2.S1 repro (chat on answered q3 surviving until its own apply consumes it) builds directly on this. Consumed by P1.M2.T2.S1 and P1.M6.T1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Rewrite the SIDECHAT-001 discard-guarantee comment above the hook (panel.ts ~941-960) to state transition semantics, the seeding rules, and the accepted same-status-reanswer edge.

tasks.title: Terminal-consume: applyChatAnswer ends the chat on a same-value no-op apply
tasks.description: On an already-answered question, a confirm-row apply of the recorded value is a correct ANSWER-PIN-001 no-op that fires no 'changed' event — so nothing discards the chat and the confirm row sticks forever. Make the apply consume pendingConfirm and close the chat when the target question is already terminal.

subtasks.title: Consume pendingConfirm and close the chat when applyChatAnswer hits an already-terminal question
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-focus.md §BUG-003 (verified firsthand). applyChatAnswer (src/panel/actions.ts ~562-578) re-seeds panel.currentId then routes decision.seam through writeInEnter / acceptOptionIndex; its JSDoc (~540-561) explicitly refuses discard/notify/pendingConfirm-clearing ('manual clearing would race a same-value no-op'). acceptOptionIndex's same-value path is AcceptOutcome "noop" (actions.ts ~229-262, 276-284) — advance only, NO applyAnswer, NO 'changed'. The hook's close ordering (abort-if-streaming → read usage → discardSidechatRecord() → setView(chatReturnView !== "chat" ? chatReturnView : "short") → sidechatNotify(formatChatCloseNotice(usage))) is the pattern to mirror — see panel.ts ~941-975. clearPendingConfirm is exported from src/panel/sidechat.ts. NOTE: clearing AFTER the seam ran, only when the question is already terminal, cannot race the no-op (the no-op already happened; nothing further will fire).
2. INPUT: The transition-aware hook from P1.M2.T1.S1 (the chat on answered q3 SURVIVES until this consume path ends it — with the old current-status hook the repro scenario is destroyed prematurely).
3. LOGIC: In applyChatAnswer, after routing through the seam: (a) clearPendingConfirm(record) unconditionally-on-apply (the decision was consumed either way); (b) if the record's question is terminal (the no-op case) mirror the hook's ordering: abort first if record.streamState === "streaming" (a second turn may be in flight), read usage, discardSidechatRecord(), close the view (panel.chatReturnView fallback "short"), panel.sidechatNotify?.(formatChatCloseNotice(usage)). The non-terminal case is UNCHANGED — the real write fires 'changed' and the hook owns discard/close/notify exactly as today (no double-notify: the hook no-ops once the record is gone). Keep byte-identical provenance: no changes to what the seams receive. Tests per PRD repro: markAnswered(q3, sqlite), open chat with convergePort proposing sqlite, send turn → pendingConfirm set; handleInput(ENTER) (no blur — P1.M1.T1.S1) → apply no-ops, getSidechat() undefined, view left "chat"→chatReturnView, notify 'chat closed · …' fired once, render contains no 'apply ★'; second enter does nothing further. Keep AC-17.4's ordinary path green (unanswered q3 → hook-driven single notify).
4. OUTPUT: 'enter → the answer applies … the chat vanishes' holds for the no-op edge (AC-17.4 tail, SIDECHAT-002 discard-on-answer); consumed by P1.M6.T1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Rewrite the applyChatAnswer JSDoc paragraph (actions.ts ~540-561 'Deliberately NOT here') to document the new consume+close contract and why post-sequence clearing does not race the no-op. README §Side chat sync owned by P1.M6.T1.

milestones.title: Replace/reset stream ownership + usage-close notices (BUG-005 + BUG-007)
milestones.description: Both chat-destruction paths that bypass the terminal-status hook — wholesale replacement via onChat and the /clear·/new reset — must mirror the close-path ordering: abort the destroyed record's in-flight stream FIRST, then destroy, then fire the compact usage-close notice.

tasks.title: onChat: abort the replaced record's stream before openOrReplace and notify its usage
tasks.description: Opening a chat on another question replaces the singleton record wholesale without aborting the replaced record's in-flight LLM call — an unabortable orphan (cost leak). Add abort-before-replace plus the missing usage-close notice.

subtasks.title: Abort-before-replace + usage notice in onChat
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-engine.md §BUG-005/§BUG-007 (verified firsthand). onChat (src/panel/panel.ts ~1057-1066) calls openSidechatRecord when questionId differs — no abort, no notify. sidechat.ts openOrReplace (~283-291) JSDoc: 'The old record's controller is NOT aborted (caller's job)'; the engine's abort() (sidechat-engine.ts ~441-448) signals the LIVE singleton only, and settle's liveness guard (getRecord() !== record → return, sites ~360/372/385/391) silently no-ops the orphan — no user gesture can stop it. The correct ordering precedent is the terminal-status hook (panel.ts ~941-975): abort-if-streaming FIRST, read usage BEFORE discard, notify via sidechatNotify(formatChatCloseNotice(usage)) — formatChatCloseNotice exported from src/panel/sidechat.ts (~496).
2. INPUT: none from other subtasks (independent seam from P1.M2 — the replace path is not status-driven). Available: record.streamState, record.abortController, record.usage, openSidechatRecord, panel.sidechatNotify.
3. LOGIC: In onChat, in the replacing branch (record !== undefined && record.questionId !== qid), before openSidechatRecord: (1) if (record.streamState === "streaming") record.abortController.abort(); (2) const usage = record.usage; (3) openSidechatRecord(qid, args.chatRebindDeps); (4) p.sidechatNotify?.(formatChatCloseNotice(usage)). Decide AND TEST one policy for the zero-usage empty record (replacing a fresh chat toasts 'chat closed · 0 in · 0 out · $0.00'): consistency with the existing hook (unconditional notify) vs suppressing all-zero notices — either is defensible; document the choice in the JSDoc and pin it in a test. The aborted turn's settle rolls back on the dead record — harmless. Tests per PRD repro: chat on q3 over a held-open gated fake port capturing the AbortSignal; blur, `o`, ↓↓↓, enter (jump to q4), `e` → record.questionId === 'q4' AND the q3 call's signal.aborted === true; plus a usage-carrying replacement asserts one notify with the exact humanized string ('chat closed · 10 in · 5 out · $0.07' from convergePort-style usage).
4. OUTPUT: No replace path can orphan an LLM call; the destroyed chat's usage is announced. Consumed by P1.M4.T2.S1's overview-replace tests (the natural repro route) and P1.M6.T1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update the onChat comment block (panel.ts ~1050-1066) to document abort-then-notify-before-replace and the zero-usage policy; README §Side chat sync owned by P1.M6.T1.

tasks.title: /clear · /new: abort the in-flight stream before resetChat and notify its usage
tasks.description: The slash-command reset path has the same two defects: classifyChatCommand runs before any streaming check, so /clear mid-stream swaps the controller out from under the in-flight call (orphaning it identically), and the reset discards messages+usage with no close notice.

subtasks.title: Abort-before-reset + usage notice in sendChatInput's command branch
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-engine.md §BUG-005/§BUG-007 (verified firsthand). sendChatInput (src/panel/panel.ts ~1743-1766): the command branch calls resetChat(this.currentId ?? "", this.chatRebindDeps) — resetChat (sidechat.ts ~466-470) rebuilds fresh with a NEW AbortController and is explicitly caller-owns-abort; nothing aborts the old controller and nothing notifies. ui-spec.md:114 (slash hatches: 'discard all messages and usage and rebind fresh; the view stays open') and :118 (Usage & close: 'any close/discard notifies compactly') — the view staying open is unchanged; only abort + notice are added. P1.M3.T1.S1 establishes the identical ordering for the sibling replace path.
2. INPUT: The mirrored ordering pattern from P1.M3.T1.S1 (not a hard data dependency — this subtask can land in parallel; follow the same policy decision for the zero-usage case for coherence).
3. LOGIC: In sendChatInput's command branch, before resetChat: (1) const record = getSidechatRecord(); if (record !== undefined) { if (record.streamState === "streaming") record.abortController.abort(); } (2) capture record.usage; (3) resetChat(...); (4) this.sidechatNotify?.(formatChatCloseNotice(usage)) — applying the SAME zero-usage policy chosen in P1.M3.T1.S1. Keep 'the view stays open' and the input clearing on the command path. Tests: streaming on q3 with a captured signal + accumulated usage → type '/clear' + enter → old signal.aborted === true, record.messages empty, record.usage zeroed ({input:0,output:0,totalCost:0}), view still "chat", notify fired once with the humanized string; also '/new' alias parity.
4. OUTPUT: The reset path aborts its orphans and announces cost; consumed by P1.M6.T1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update the sendChatInput doc comment (panel.ts ~1726-1742, 'The input clears on EVERY path' paragraph is P1.M4.T1.S1's to revise — coordinate so the final comment covers both changes coherently) and the slash-command branch. README §Side chat sync owned by P1.M6.T1.

milestones.title: Input preservation + overview chat targeting (BUG-006 + BUG-004)
milestones.description: Two interaction-model corrections: typed chat input survives an enter pressed while a reply streams (draft-sacredness on the last unprotected text surface), and `e` in the overview opens the chat on the cursor row's question, not the background question.

tasks.title: Preserve typed chat input when sendTurn refuses
tasks.description: sendChatInput clears the buffer on every path, including the streaming-refusal path where nothing was sent — the typed follow-up silently vanishes. Keep the text when the engine refuses.

subtasks.title: Keep the buffer when sendTurn returns false (streaming refusal)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/bugfix/001_7ea23709b4e7/architecture/sidechat-engine.md §BUG-006 (verified firsthand). sendChatInput (src/panel/panel.ts ~1743-1766) calls this.sidechatEngine?.sendTurn(text) ignoring its boolean, then unconditionally this.chatField.setText(""); the module doc says 'The input clears on EVERY path'. sendTurn returns false when the record is missing or streamState !== "idle" ('no queueing, no double-controller — the esc rung aborts instead', sidechat-engine.ts ~399-401). PRD fix: 'keep the text when sendTurn returns false'. Draft-sacredness authority: ui-spec commitment 6 / R4.
2. INPUT: none from other subtasks. Note the interplay with P1.M1.T1.S1: a DECISION-bearing settle blurs the input (text preserved — blur never clears); a non-decision settle keeps focus so the user can keep typing; this subtask guarantees that typed text also survives a refused enter mid-stream.
3. LOGIC: Capture the return: const sent = this.sidechatEngine?.sendTurn(text) ?? false; clear the buffer ONLY when sent (the command path still always clears — it was accepted by definition). Revise the doc comment: the input clears on every ACCEPTED path; a refused turn preserves the draft. Optional polish ONLY if a cheap existing seam exists (panel.flash): a transient 'reply in flight — esc aborts' flash on refusal — do not build new UI for it. Tests per PRD repro: open chat, send a message over a held-open streaming port; chatField.setText('follow-up question'); handleInput("\r") → chatField.getText() === 'follow-up question', record.messages has NO new user turn, streamState still 'streaming'; then let the port complete and re-press enter → the follow-up sends and the buffer clears.
4. OUTPUT: The chat input honors draft-sacredness; consumed by P1.M6.T1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Rewrite the sendChatInput doc comment (panel.ts ~1726-1742) — coordinate with P1.M3.T2.S1's comment update on the same function so the final text covers both. README §Side chat sync owned by P1.M6.T1.

tasks.title: Overview `e` opens the chat on the cursor row's question
tasks.description: In the overview the interaction model is cursor-row-centric (enter jumps to the cursor row), but the chat key binds to the background currentId. Route the chat dispatch to the cursor-row question, matching the prev/next overview-branch pattern.

milestones.title: Reconstruction degrade-to-next-older for tool results (BUG-008)
